sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the use of sepiapterin during breastfeeding. If a mother requires sepiapterin, it is not a reason to discontinue breastfeeding. However, an alternate drug may be preferred, especially while nursing a newborn or preterm infant.
